title: Search for target objects on countertops before checking cabinets
description: Use this when looking for common household items like mugs that are often placed on visible surfaces.
content: When searching for a mug or similar everyday object, check countertops and other open surfaces first, as they are frequently placed there rather than inside closed cabinets.

title: Cool objects by using the fridge with the object in hand
description: Use this when a task requires cooling an object that is not already inside a fridge.
content: To cool an item, first pick it up, then go to the fridge and use the "cool [object] with [fridge]" action while holding it.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some mug and put it in coffeemachine.

title: Complete cooling before moving to the final destination
description: Use this when a task involves both a state change (like cooling) and a final placement.
content: Perform the state-changing action (e.g., cooling) on the object before transporting it to the final destination, ensuring the object is in the required state when placed.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some mug and put it in coffeemachine.

title: Locate multiple target objects before transporting them
description: Use when a task requires moving multiple instances of the same object type to a destination.
content: When the task requires multiple identical objects, first search the environment to find all instances before moving them. If an attempt to take a second object from the same location fails, check your inventory to confirm what you are carrying, then return to the source location to retrieve the remaining object.

title: Open containers before placing items inside
description: Use when the destination is a closed container such as a fridge or cabinet.
content: Before moving an item into a closed container, open it first. Once the container is open, use the move action to place the item inside, and the container can remain open for subsequent items.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two lettuce in fridge.

title: Transport items one at a time when inventory is limited
description: Use when multiple objects need to be moved but only one can be carried at a time.
content: If you can only carry one item at a time, move each object to the destination individually. After placing the first item, return to the source location to pick up the next item and repeat the process until all required objects are moved.

title: Locate target object by checking multiple storage surfaces
description: Use this when the target object is not visible in the current location and multiple similar storage locations exist.
content: When searching for an object, systematically visit each plausible storage surface (e.g., shelves, tables) and inspect the listed objects. The target object may be on a different surface than the first one checked.

title: Pick up object before navigating to destination
description: Use this when the task requires moving an object from one location to another.
content: Once the target object is found, take it immediately to add it to inventory. Then navigate to the destination location and use the move action to place the object there.

title: Use move action to place held object at destination
description: Use this when you have the target object in inventory and have arrived at the destination location.
content: After arriving at the destination with the object in hand, issue a move command specifying the object and the destination to complete the placement task.
